item.name: Capture screenshots of multiple websites in a single request.

request.name: Capture screenshots of multiple websites in a single request.

description.content:
Our Bulk Screenshot API allows you to capture screenshots of multiple webpages simultaneously, saving you time and effort. Instead of manually capturing each page one by one, you can batch process URLs and receive high-quality screenshots in the format you choose.
 Maximum `50 URLs` per request.

response.name: Successful response. Each item in `results` corresponds to one requested URL, in the same order; a URL that fails validation or capture returns an error object in its `url` field instead of screenshot data, while `status` stays "fulfilled" and `error_message` stays null.

item.name: Build screenshots the way real users see the web — not just what fits on the screen.

request.name: Build screenshots the way real users see the web — not just what fits on the screen.

description.content:
Capture full-page screenshots and videos of websites with advanced options like device simulation, custom code injection, cookie banner blocking, and scrollable content recording.
Supports multiple output formats including JSON, image, GIF, MP4, and WebM.
